# DOC (S14): the documentation site's build tools (mkdocs.yml, .github/workflows/site.yml), hash-pinned.
# Not a package extra: the docs tooling never ships in the wheel. This file is the increment over
# requirements.lock (the pattern of requirements-coolprop.lock): a package the lock pins is not repeated
# here, so the two never disagree. Install it after requirements.lock and the project:
#     python -m pip install --no-deps --require-hashes -r requirements-docs.txt
# Top-level requirements: mkdocs<2, mkdocs-material<10, mkdocstrings[python], mkdocs-jupyter
# (Material's 2.x line is not backward compatible; pin until the site is migrated). Regenerate with
#     uv pip compile <those four, one per line> -c requirements.lock --generate-hashes \
#         --python-version 3.13 --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28
# and drop every package requirements.lock pins (DOC_DECISIONS D5). This file is not a dependency-set
# identity: run manifests record requirements.lock's hash only (R-140).
